current_behavior: NutritionProfileV1 preserves raw value, unit, comparison, evidence and label-rounding, and has nullable fields plus upper bounds.
The Markdown adapter maps its reviewed missing tokens to null, but does not retain why a value is missing or whether a number was analysed, calculated or imputed.
The evidence validator accepts exact and less-than numeric cells; the model selects server-issued row IDs and does not supply values.
NutritionProfileV1 defines complete/partial from numeric point presence, so a numeric imputed zero currently cannot be distinguished from a measured zero in profile status or coverage.
The profile cell validator rejects unrecognized top-level cell fields; inserting a new status there without a versioned contract change would fail validation.

cell_contract.numeric: Preserve original decimal text, unit and exact/less-than comparison; add server-adapter-owned value_status plus status evidence/source reference.
cell_contract.imputed_zero: Require an explicit source statement that the zero is imputed and a numeric value exactly equal to zero; do not infer from an ordinary 0 cell.
cell_contract.missing: Keep value null and preserve the source-supported missing reason; when the source does not disambiguate a blank/dash, use unknown rather than guessing.
cell_contract.comparison: Keep exact versus less_than independent from analytical/derived/imputed origin; a bound is not missing and is not a point value.

proposed_semantics_not_implemented.authority: Only a reviewed source-specific server adapter may assign derivation/value/missing statuses from source documentation. The model may select source row IDs only; it must not invent value origin or fill missing fields.
proposed_semantics_not_implemented.calculation_and_display: Never coerce null to zero. A documented numeric imputed_zero remains a numeric source observation only when the source-specific policy allows it, and must remain explicitly labelled as imputed in profile, coverage and UI. Complete numeric coverage must not be presented as all-analytical coverage.
proposed_semantics_not_implemented.versioning: NutritionProfileV1 does not preserve these distinctions. Introduce a versioned profile/extraction contract and update backend validators, persistence, read models, frontend types and coverage before adopting such records; do not smuggle statuses into unvalidated V1 fields.

decision.reason: This is a conservative contract proposal only. Rights for AFCD public-app reuse and durable profiles remain unresolved, and the proposal needs a product/schema review before versioned implementation.

next_gate: Obtain the FSANZ written clarification and project-owner decision documented in batch 87.
Review this semantic model against the desired user-facing meaning of AFCD values and approve or amend the versioned contract before coding.
If approved and reuse is cleared, implement provenance-aware field validation/coverage before any AFCD real-value extraction or persistence.
Only then run a bounded, rights-approved source-format adapter test; do not claim photo-pipeline or nutrition-accuracy validation.
review_limits: The proposed status names are a design draft, not an implemented API or migration contract.
Source-specific status mapping cannot be inferred from a numeric cell alone.
No real AFCD nutrient values were used or copied into this artifact.
The review does not resolve FSANZ licensing or third-party rights.
